name: web_visual_scout
description:
web_visual_scout:

Take a screenshot of the current page and return a detailed prose description of:
- layout and navigation structure
- blockers/modals/overlays intercepting clicks
- carousels/slide windows and other complex UI
- what looks clickable even if it’s an image tile

This tool does NOT return coordinates. Use it when progress stalls and you need a “human-like” view of the UI.
